en.headline: Observatory cancels amber rainstorm warning at 7:30pm
en.dek: The amber signal is down, but a thunderstorm warning runs until 9pm and Tai Po remains under a flooding alert.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 7:30pm on Friday, after issuing it at 5:40pm as heavy showers affected the northern New Territories. In a message dispatched at 7:30pm, the Observatory said the amber signal was no longer in force.

A Thunderstorm Warning issued at 3:55pm remains in effect and was extended until 9pm, the Observatory said in a separate dispatch at 7:45pm. Isolated thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong. People outdoors are advised to seek shelter, stay out of the water, and keep away from high ground, trees and metal masts.

The Observatory's 8pm weather report said that, although the rainstorm warning had been cancelled, the public should still watch for the danger of flooding in watercourses. A special announcement said rain was particularly heavy in Tai Po, where serious flooding was possible, and that the district had recorded or was expected to record more than 70 millimetres of rain in an hour. The Observatory recorded 28 degrees and 86 per cent humidity at 8pm.

Earlier in the afternoon the Observatory had also warned of a flooding risk around Sheung Shui. Northeast monsoon winds and an upper-air disturbance have been bringing showers and thunderstorms to the Pearl River estuary. The weekend outlook published earlier on Friday still expects cloudy weather with showers on Saturday before a cooler Monday.

zh.headline: 天文台晚上7時30分取消黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 黃雨信號已經取消，雷暴警告維持至晚上9時，大埔仍有水浸特別提示。
body: 香港天文台星期五下午5時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，新界北部早段雨勢較大。天文台在晚上7時30分的消息指，黃色暴雨警告信號已經取消。
下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告仍然生效。天文台在晚上7時45分的消息指，警告已延長至晚上9時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。市民在戶外應盡快找安全地方躲避，離開水面，不要游泳或進行其他水上活動，亦不要站在高地，並遠離導電物體、樹木及桅杆。
天文台晚上8時的天氣報告指出，雖然暴雨警告已經取消，市民仍須留意河道泛濫可能帶來的危險。同一報告的特別天氣提示指，大埔區雨勢特別大，有可能出現嚴重水浸，該區已錄得或預料會有每小時超過70毫米雨量。晚上8時天文台錄得氣溫28度，相對濕度86%。
天文台下午較早時亦曾提示上水一帶有水浸風險。東北季候風及高空擾動正為珠江口帶來驟雨及雷暴。天文台星期五較早時公布的周末展望仍預料星期六大致多雲有驟雨，星期一會轉涼。
